simulation_brief.summary: A fictional ride-hailing platform is preparing or beginning a test of a new driver-rating explanation screen. Drivers expect fairer treatment and fewer unexplained deactivations, riders prioritize safety, support staff anticipate possible ticket-volume changes, and management seeks fewer appeals and smoother governance. T0 contains unresolved tradeoffs rather than a full crisis.
